description: MANDATORY STEP 1 for personal coaching turns: single-call deterministic coaching brief returning the athlete's profile, goals, active pain & biomechanical constraints, EWMA acute/chronic load (ACWR), 17-muscle weekly MEV/MAV/MRV audit, measured Wathan e1RMs & sub-muscle diagnostics, focus-ranked athlete equipment/preference memories, and recent completed + planned sessions (`days`, default 14). Pass `focus` summarizing the athlete's request. Requires Bearer token.

focus.description: Concise 1-sentence summary of what the athlete is asking in this turn (e.g. 'building a 4-day powerlifting block', 'checking squat progression', 'auditing weekly back volume') so STRUGGL ranks relevant athlete memories and context.

name: get_coaching_brief
